item.title: Ocean mapping coalition publishes atlas of underwater mountains
item.description: A ten-year effort to chart the seafloor wraps up with a nearly complete picture of the planet's hidden ranges.
item.dc:creator: Demo Desk
item.content:encoded: Researchers say the atlas records tens of thousands of seamounts.
